title: SAT belongs to NP
statement: The language of binary strings whose total CNF decoding is satisfiable belongs to NP: there are natural numbers $C,c$ and a language $V$ decidable in polynomial time such that, for every binary string $x$, membership is equivalent to the existence of a string $u$ with $|u|=C(|x|+1)^c$ and $xu\in V$.
replaced:
The language $\mathrm{SAT}$ — binary strings whose total CNF decoding is
satisfiable — belongs to $\mathrm{NP}$: a satisfying assignment, encoded as a
certificate of exactly $|x| + 1$ bits, is verified in polynomial time.
[AB09, Theorem~2.10, membership]
